create_pipeline_stage: create a concurrent pipeline stage that processes items from an input queue through an async function
create_ordered_pipeline_stage: create a pipeline stage that processes items concurrently while preserving the original input order
create_fail_counter_hook: create a task failure counter hook with configurable max failure thresholds as int or fraction rate
merge_pipeline_queues: merge items from multiple input queues into a single output queue with optional custom merge operation
disaggregate_list_to_async_iterator: convert a list of items into an async iterator that yields each item sequentially
